title: Port Forwarding
desc: Forward TCP / UDP traffic from local ports to LAN or external addresses
moduleOffTitle: The port forwarding module is disabled
empty: No rules yet. Add one, or import a Lucky config under "Settings → Backup & Migration"
protocolHelp: tcp/udp is dual-stack IPv4+IPv6; a 4/6 suffix restricts it to that address family
listenAddressPlaceholder: Leave empty to listen on all addresses
targetAddressPlaceholder: One per line; multiple addresses are used round-robin with automatic failover
targetPortsPlaceholder: Leave empty to match the listen ports; the counts must match, or enter just one
savedRestarted: Saved. Rules restarted with the new settings
proxyProtocolHelp: TCP only. Sends a PROXY protocol header after connecting to the target so the downstream learns the real client address (haproxy accept-proxy, nginx proxy_protocol, or "Accept PROXY protocol" in Gately Web Services). Connections fail if the target does not support it.
modeForwardHelp: Forward traffic on the listening port straight to the target
modeSniHelp: Read the domain (SNI) from the TLS handshake and pass the connection through to a backend chosen by domain. TLS is not decrypted here. Lets several services share port 443, replacing haproxy's req_ssl_sni routing
routeDomainsPlaceholder: Domains, one per line: vpn.example.com, *.example.com or *
sniRoutesHelp: Exact domains win, then the longest *. wildcard, then *. Case-insensitive. An empty target port means the same as the listening port. PROXY protocol is set per route
defaultTargetPlaceholder: Used when no route matches, there is no SNI, or the connection is not TLS. Leave empty to drop the connection
defaultTargetNone: Not set, unmatched connections are dropped ({rejected} dropped)
filterPlaceholder: Search name, group, port, target or domain
